title: Análisis textual discursivo para la construcción de significados sociales complejos Discursive textual analysis for the construction of complex social meanings
text_snippet: Análisis textual discursivo para la construcción de significados sociales complejos Discursive textual analysis for the construction of complex social meanings El objetivo fue explicitar y ejemplificar la implementación del análisis textual discursivo (ATD) como dispositivo de producción de conocimiento emergente en un estudio de caso sobre legitimidad institucional en una universidad católica mexicana. Se desarrolló un estudio cualitativo de caso único instrumental, sustentado interpretativamente en el interaccionismo simbólico y la fenomenología social. El corpus comprendió documentos institucionales, 13 entrevistas semiestructuradas con actores internos y externos y dos grupos focales, de ocho y siete integrantes. La selección fue intencional, atendiendo a la trayectoria, posición institucional y experiencia de los participantes. El análisis se organizó en tres movimientos recursivos: unitarización, categorización y elaboración de metatextos, con triangulación de técnicas y fuentes. Los resultados ejemplifican, de manera trazable, el tránsito de los fragmentos a las unidades de significado y su articulación en categorías iniciales, intermedias y relacionales, entre ellas la legitimidad apoyada en dispositivos externos de validación. title: Conciencia ambiental frente a la triple crisis planetaria en el Perú: una revisión teórico-documental Environmental awareness in the face of the triple planetary crisis in Peru: a theoretical-documentary review
text_snippet: Conciencia ambiental frente a la triple crisis planetaria en el Perú: una revisión teórico-documental Environmental awareness in the face of the triple planetary crisis in Peru: a theoretical-documentary review El objetivo fue analizar e integrar evidencia científica y documental sobre cambio climático, pérdida de biodiversidad, contaminación y residuos sólidos municipales, con énfasis en el contexto peruano, para proponer una síntesis teórica que vincule el conocimiento de la triple crisis planetaria con la formación de conciencia ambiental. Se realizó una revisión teórico-documental narrativa de 70 referencias citadas en el manuscrito, entre artículos científicos, informes nacionales e internacionales, normativa y fuentes institucionales. La búsqueda se efectuó principalmente en Google Académico y se complementó con documentos oficiales seleccionados por su relevancia temática y autoridad institucional. El análisis se organizó en cuatro ejes: residuos sólidos municipales, cambio climático, pérdida de biodiversidad y contaminación, posteriormente integrados mediante una síntesis interpretativa. Los resultados evidencian interdependencia entre los componentes de la triple crisis y la gestión de residuos. title: Percepciones estudiantiles sobre la formación en competencias digitales e inteligencia artificial en la formación inicial docente: prioridades curriculares en una universidad ecuatoriana Student perceptions of training in digital competencies and artificial intelligence in initial teacher education: curriculum priorities at an ecuadorian university

A quantitative, descriptive, cross-sectional study was conducted. All 470 students enrolled from the first through eighth levels during the 2026A academic term were invited to participate; 468 valid questionnaires were analyzed, representing 99.6% coverage of the census frame. A 31-item institutional questionnaire was used; for this article, items 11–15 from the Innovation and Technology dimension and item 31, addressing curricular priority, were analyzed. title: Impacto de la educación virtual en el desarrollo de competencias profesionales en estudiantes universitarios en el contexto pospandemia Impact of virtual education on the development of professional competencies in university students in the post-covid-19 context
text_snippet: Impacto de la educación virtual en el desarrollo de competencias profesionales en estudiantes universitarios en el contexto pospandemia Impact of virtual education on the development of professional competencies in university students in the post-covid-19 context Virtual education gained particular relevance during and after the COVID-19 health crisis, prompting the reorganization of pedagogical models in higher education. The aim of this study was to analyze the available evidence regarding the relationship between virtual education and the development of professional competencies among university students in the post-pandemic context. To this end, a descriptive systematic review was conducted following the general phases of the PRISMA methodology. The search was carried out in Scielo, Redalyc, Renati, Dialnet, and Horizontes databases, yielding an initial total of 1,172 records. After applying the inclusion and exclusion criteria, 13 studies were selected for the final analysis. The findings revealed a predominantly favorable trend regarding the contribution of virtual education to the development of professional competencies, particularly in dimensions related to autonomy, the use of digital tools, self-regulated learning, and adaptation to technology-mediated environments. title: El trabajo social en los equipos de orientación escolar: intervenciones, afectaciones y sufrimiento de adolescentes y jóvenes Social work in school guidance teams: interventions, effects, and suffering of adolescents and young people
text_snippet: El trabajo social en los equipos de orientación escolar: intervenciones, afectaciones y sufrimiento de adolescentes y jóvenes Social work in school guidance teams: interventions, effects, and suffering of adolescents and young people El artículo busca analizar las intervenciones de profesionales de Trabajo Social en equipos interdisciplinarios de institucionales escolares y los dispositivos de acompañamiento a las trayectorias educativas en escenarios de profundización de las desigualdades. A partir de un estudio cualitativo exploratorio y descriptivo, se desarrollan entrevistas en profundidad a trabajadoras sociales de escuelas públicas inscriptas en zonas urbanas y periféricas de la Provincia de Buenos Aires, Argentina. Se exponen las características que asumen los límites y las posibilidades de intervención frente a los intersticios de marcos normativos y protocolos en situaciones socio educativas. Se concluye que estos equipos se constituyen en espacios de pertenencia de jóvenes y adolescentes que encuentran en la vida institucional un lugar donde poner en palabras sus emociones y necesidades, en contextos de incertidumbre y precariedad material y subjetiva. Esto opera como punto de partida para construir estrategias interdisciplinarias, interinstitucionales y locales para garantía de soportes materiales y afectivos. title: Participatory strategies in french language learning in university students, 2025 Estrategias participativas en el aprendizaje del idioma francés en estudiantes universitarios, 2025
text_snippet: Participatory strategies in french language learning in university students, 2025 Estrategias participativas en el aprendizaje del idioma francés en estudiantes universitarios, 2025 La presente investigación tuvo como objetivo determinar la asociación entre las estrategias participativas y el aprendizaje del idioma francés en estudiantes de una universidad pública de Lambayeque durante el año 2025. El estudio corresponde al diseño no experimental de corte transversal y alcance correlacional-predictivo. La población estuvo conformada por 170 estudiantes y la muestra por 100 participantes seleccionados mediante un muestreo no probabilístico por conveniencia. Para la recolección de datos se empleó la técnica de la encuesta. La variable estrategias participativas fue evaluada mediante un cuestionario de 18 ítems, mientras que el aprendizaje del idioma francés fue medido a través de una evaluación de desempeño compuesta por 16 ítems. title: Método dual del Árbol de la Vida y Aprendizaje Significativo: Desarrollo, Competencias Gerenciales y Turismo Agroecológico. Dual method of the tree of life and meaningful learning: development, management competencies and agroecological tourism
text_snippet: Método dual del Árbol de la Vida y Aprendizaje Significativo: Desarrollo, Competencias Gerenciales y Turismo Agroecológico. Dual method of the tree of life and meaningful learning: development, management competencies and agroecological tourism The aim of this study was to analyze the contribution of the Tree of Life method and Meaningful Learning to the development of managerial competencies in the context of agroecological tourism, addressing the existing training needs within this sector. A qualitative study with a descriptive-interpretative scope was conducted, based on the phenomenological-hermeneutic method. Data were collected through purposive sampling involving 175 participants distributed into five groups, with five key informants whose narratives were examined using content analysis and triangulation techniques. The findings revealed that the integration of the Tree of Life method and Meaningful Learning promotes reflection on personal and professional experiences, contributing to the strengthening of competencies related to leadership, planning, resilience, and decision-making. Furthermore, the results suggest that this approach represents a relevant educational alternative for fostering management practices guided by principles of sustainability, responsibility, and ethical commitment in the field of agroecological tourism.

title: Impacto de la educación virtual en el desarrollo de competencias profesionales en estudiantes universitarios en el contexto pospandemia Impact of virtual education on the development of professional competencies in university students in the post-covid-19 context
text_snippet: Impacto de la educación virtual en el desarrollo de competencias profesionales en estudiantes universitarios en el contexto pospandemia Impact of virtual education on the development of professional competencies in university students in the post-covid-19 context La educación virtual adquirió especial relevancia durante y después de la crisis sanitaria ocasionada por la Covid-19, al impulsar la reorganización de los modelos pedagógicos en la educación superior. El objetivo del estudio fue analizar la evidencia disponible sobre la relación entre la educación virtual y el desarrollo de competencias profesionales en estudiantes universitarios en el contexto pospandemia. Para ello, se realizó una revisión sistemática de alcance descriptivo, siguiendo las fases generales de la metodología PRISMA. La búsqueda se efectuó en las bases Scielo, Redalyc, Renati, Dialnet y Horizontes, identificándose inicialmente 1172 documentos. Luego de aplicar criterios de inclusión y exclusión, se seleccionaron 13 estudios para el análisis final. Los resultados muestran una tendencia predominantemente favorable respecto a la contribución de la educación virtual al desarrollo de competencias profesionales, especialmente en dimensiones vinculadas con la autonomía, el uso de herramientas digitales, la autogestión del aprendizaje y la adaptación a entornos mediados por tecnología. title: Phubbing, FoMO, adicción a las redes sociales y salud mental en universitarios Phubbing, FoMO, social media addiction and mental health in university students
text_snippet: Phubbing, FoMO, adicción a las redes sociales y salud mental en universitarios Phubbing, FoMO, social media addiction and mental health in university students Este estudio tuvo como objetivo analizar la asociación entre la adicción a las redes sociales, el phubbing, el miedo a perderse algo (FoMO) y los síntomas de depresión, ansiedad y estrés en estudiantes universitarios. La investigación se desarrolló bajo un enfoque cuantitativo, con un diseño no experimental, transversal y de alcance descriptivo-correlacional. La muestra estuvo conformada por 208 estudiantes universitarios de entre 18 y 25 años, a quienes se les aplicaron la Escala de Phubbing, la Fear of Missing Out Scale (FoMOs), la Bergen Social Media Addiction Scale (BSMAS) y la Depression Anxiety Stress Scale-21 (DASS-21). Los resultados evidenciaron puntajes promedio bajos a intermedios en las dimensiones asociadas al uso problemático de las redes sociales y en los indicadores de malestar emocional. Asimismo, se identificaron correlaciones positivas y estadísticamente significativas entre el FoMO, el phubbing y la adicción a las redes sociales con los síntomas de estrés, ansiedad y depresión. En conjunto, los hallazgos sugieren la existencia de asociaciones relevantes entre determinadas conductas vinculadas al uso de las tecnologías digitales y los indicadores de salud mental

title: Dependencia tecnológica y habilidades comunicativas en estudiantes universitarios de Lima Technological dependence and communication skills among university students in Lima
text_snippet: Dependencia tecnológica y habilidades comunicativas en estudiantes universitarios de Lima Technological dependence and communication skills among university students in Lima El presente estudio tuvo como objetivo analizar la relación entre la dependencia tecnológica y las habilidades comunicativas en estudiantes universitarios de Lima. Aunque existen numerosas investigaciones sobre el uso de las tecnologías en la educación superior, aún son limitados los estudios que examinan de manera específica su asociación con las competencias comunicativas en el contexto peruano. Se desarrolló una investigación con enfoque cuantitativo, diseño no experimental, transversal y correlacional. La muestra estuvo conformada por 153 estudiantes de la Escuela Profesional de Sociología de la Universidad Nacional Mayor de San Marcos, seleccionados mediante un muestreo probabilístico estratificado. Para la recolección de la información se aplicaron dos cuestionarios estructurados de 24 ítems cada uno. El primero evaluó la dependencia tecnológica en las dimensiones uso compulsivo del celular, phubbing y generación muda, mientras que el segundo midió las habilidades comunicativas en expresión verbal, comprensión lectora y producción escrita. title: El Trabajo Social en los Equipos de Orientación Escolar: intervenciones, afectaciones y sufrimiento de adolescentes y jóvenes Social Work in School Guidance Teams: interventions, effects, and suffering of adolescents and young people
text_snippet: El Trabajo Social en los Equipos de Orientación Escolar: intervenciones, afectaciones y sufrimiento de adolescentes y jóvenes Social Work in School Guidance Teams: interventions, effects, and suffering of adolescents and young people The article aims to analyze the interventions of Social Work professionals in interdisciplinary teams of school institutions and the support devices for the trajectories of students in scenarios of deepening inequalities. Based on an exploratory and descriptive qualitative study, in-depth interviews are conducted with social workers from public schools located in urban and peripheral areas of the Province of Buenos Aires, Argentina. The characteristics that define the limits and possibilities of intervention in the interstices of normative frameworks and protocols in socio-educational situations are discussed. It is concluded that these teams become spaces of belonging for young people and adolescents who find in institutional life a place to express their emotions and needs, in contexts of uncertainty and material and subjective precariousness. This serves as a starting point for building interdisciplinary strategies, Inter-institutional and local collaborations to ensure material and emotional support. title: Estrategias participativas en el aprendizaje del idioma francés en estudiantes universitarios, 2025 Participatory strategies in french language learning in university students, 2025
text_snippet: Estrategias participativas en el aprendizaje del idioma francés en estudiantes universitarios, 2025 Participatory strategies in french language learning in university students, 2025 The aim of this study was to determine the association between participatory strategies and French language learning among students from a public university in Lambayeque during 2025. The study followed a non-experimental, cross-sectional design with a correlational-predictive scope. The population consisted of 170 students, and the sample comprised 100 participants selected through non-probability convenience sampling. Data were collected using the survey technique. Participatory strategies were assessed through an 18-item questionnaire, whereas French language learning was measured using a 16-item performance assessment. Both instruments showed adequate content validity (Aiken’s V = 0.99) and high internal consistency (Cronbach’s α = 0.921 and α = 0.916, respectively). Descriptive results revealed that 57% of the students perceived participatory strategies as efficient, while 58% exhibited a regular level of French language learning. title: Entre alfabetización mediática e informacional y controversia social: enseñar convivencia digital como práctica de ciudadanía crítica Between media and information literacy and social controversy: teaching digital coexistence as a practice of critical citizenship
text_snippet: Entre alfabetización mediática e informacional y controversia social: enseñar convivencia digital como práctica de ciudadanía crítica Between media and information literacy and social controversy: teaching digital coexistence as a practice of critical citizenship In the context of the expansion of digital culture, coexistence in virtual environments has become a socially acute issue that challenges processes of civic education in secondary schooling. This single case study, grounded in a qualitative and descriptive-interpretive approach, analyzes how digital citizenship is constructed through teaching practices focused on digital coexistence in a first-year class at a private secondary school in the Autonomous City of Buenos Aires. The aim is to understand how teaching controversial digital issues enables processes of deliberation, negotiation of meaning, and the situated construction of ethical positions. The research was conducted through a cooperative design involving teachers and researchers and was based on the analysis of classroom records, student productions, interviews, and pedagogical materials. The findings show that addressing digital coexistence as a socially acute issue transforms the classroom into an agonistic space where tensions emerge among youth experiences, institutional discourses, and the sociotechnical logics of digital platforms. title: Editorial
text_snippet: Editorial Issue 28 brings together manuscripts that highlight three central concerns. The first is linked to digital transformation in educational and social processes. The second reflects a growing emphasis on holistic well-being and on the centrality of the human person. Finally, the third underscores the need to foster pedagogical innovations capable of responding to the demands of a constantly changing society.

title: Entre alfabetización mediática e informacional y controversia social: enseñar convivencia digital como práctica de ciudadanía crítica Between media and information literacy and social controversy: teaching digital coexistence as a practice of critical citizenship
text_snippet: Entre alfabetización mediática e informacional y controversia social: enseñar convivencia digital como práctica de ciudadanía crítica Between media and information literacy and social controversy: teaching digital coexistence as a practice of critical citizenship En el contexto de la expansión de la cultura digital, la convivencia en entornos virtuales se configura como una cuestión socialmente viva que interpela los procesos de formación ciudadana en la educación secundaria. Este estudio de caso único, de enfoque cualitativo y de carácter descriptivo-interpretativo, analiza cómo se construye la ciudadanía digital a partir de prácticas de enseñanza sobre convivencia digital en un curso de primer año de una escuela secundaria privada de la Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires. El objetivo consiste en comprender de qué modo la enseñanza de problemáticas digitales controvertidas habilita procesos de deliberación, negociación de sentidos y construcción situada de posicionamientos éticos. La investigación se desarrolló mediante un diseño cooperativo entre docentes e investigadoras, y se basó en el análisis de registros de clase, producciones estudiantiles, entrevistas y materiales pedagógicos. title: Aplicación de la estrategia de estados mediante la ingeniería didáctica Application of state strategy through didactic engineering
text_snippet: Aplicación de la estrategia de estados mediante la ingeniería didáctica Application of state strategy through didactic engineering The present study aimed to analyze the effectiveness of the States Strategy through the History of Mathematics (EEHM) in first-year university students. The research employed a pre-experimental design with a single group and the application of pretest and posttest instruments, which allowed for the assessment of changes produced after the implementation of the strategy. The sample consisted of 23 participants, selected from introductory mathematics courses. A structured questionnaire was used as the research instrument, designed to collect information on various aspects of mathematical learning and students’ perceptions regarding the implementation of the EEHM. The results indicated that the application of this strategy fostered more meaningful and effective learning, as evidenced by greater conceptual understanding, improved problem-solving skills, and a more active and participatory attitude during the sessions.In summary, it is concluded that the EEHM contributes to the development of logical reasoning, critical reflection, and motivation toward mathematics, strengthening a positive disposition toward learning and problem-solving both inside and outside the classroom.

title: Editorial
text_snippet: Editorial El número 27 de la Revista EDUCA UMCH nace en un tiempo de incertidumbre. Un tiempo en el que la educación ya no habita únicamente las aulas, sino también las pantallas; ya no se transmite solo por la voz del docente, sino que se construye en la interacción, la autonomía y la búsqueda constante de sentido. Las investigaciones reunidas en este volumen dialogan entre sí como piezas de un mismo mapa, orientadas a comprender y transformar los procesos educativos en escenarios atravesados por la virtualización, la diversidad cultural, la innovación pedagógica y la exigencia de una formación académica con calidad y humanidad.

title: Uso de actividades didácticas lúdicas en el aprendizaje ortográfico: estudio preexperimental en estudiantes de primaria
text_snippet: Uso de actividades didácticas lúdicas en el aprendizaje ortográfico: estudio preexperimental en estudiantes de primaria El estudio tuvo como objetivo evaluar el uso de actividades didácticas lúdicas en el aprendizaje ortográfico en estudiantes de quinto grado de una institución educativa pública de Medellín, Colombia. Se desarrolló un estudio mixto, de alcance exploratorio, con diseño preexperimental de un solo grupo con medición pretest–postest. Participaron 25 estudiantes seleccionados mediante muestreo intencional. Se aplicaron una prueba diagnóstica y una prueba final de desempeño ortográfico, un cuestionario abierto a docentes, una encuesta de percepción estudiantil y una ficha de observación. El análisis cuantitativo se realizó mediante estadística descriptiva y el cualitativo mediante análisis temático con triangulación de fuentes. Los resultados mostraron incrementos en palabras homónimas, puntuación y mayúsculas, y acentuación, además de mejoras en lamotivación, participación y autoconfianza. Se concluye que la intervención se asocia con mejoras en el aprendizaje ortográfico; sin embargo, los hallazgos deben interpretarse como evidencia exploratoria debido al diseño del estudio y al tamaño muestral

title: Modelo de redacción escalonada para el desarrollo de la escritura académica Scaffolded writing model for academic writing development
text_snippet: Modelo de redacción escalonada para el desarrollo de la escritura académica Scaffolded writing model for academic writing development The aim of this study was to evaluate the application of a scaffolded writing model in the development of academic writing among university students. A mixed-method approach with a quantitative predominance was adopted, using a quasi-experimental pretest-posttest design with a non-equivalent control group. The sample consisted of 41 students selected through non-probabilistic convenience sampling, distributed into an experimental group (n = 21), which participated in a structured instructional intervention based on progressive modules, and a control group (n = 20), which did not receive the intervention. Data were collected using validated and reliable analytical rubrics, as well as academic writing tests. The analysis included both descriptive and inferential statistics. A paired-samples t-test was applied to compare pretest and posttest results, and effect size was estimated using Cohen’s d. Additionally, an analysis of covariance (ANCOVA) was conducted to compare group performance while controlling for baseline differences. title: Estilos de liderazgo directivo y la evaluación del desempeño docente en una institución educativa pública de la UGEL Nº 04 Leadership styles of school principals and the evaluation of teacher performance in a public educational institution under UGEL No. 04

title: Evaluación del aprendizaje en el enfoque de capacidades en educación superior: una revisión sistemática Learning evaluation in the capabilities approach in higher education: a systematic review
text_snippet: Evaluación del aprendizaje en el enfoque de capacidades en educación superior: una revisión sistemática Learning evaluation in the capabilities approach in higher education: a systematic review The article presents the results of a systematic review on the assessment of learning from the capability approach in higher education. The identified problem lies in the fact that, although higher education curricula—including teacher education—declare the adoption of this approach, the assessment practices applied to students are not always consistent with its principles. In this context, the objective of the study was to identify the characteristics of the capability approach that are considered in learning assessment within higher education institutions. The review was conducted through a systematic search of academic databases and the Information System on Educational Trends in Latin America (SITEAL), which made it possible to identify relevant gaps in the literature, particularly regarding the theoretical and practical articulation between learning assessment and the capability approach. Nevertheless, convergences were found around emerging assessment practices, such as formative assessment, aimed at valuing student autonomy, diversity, and critical thinking. title: Evaluación del aprendizaje en el enfoque de capacidades en educación superior: una revisión sistemática Learning evaluation in the capabilities approach in higher education: a systematic review
text_snippet: Evaluación del aprendizaje en el enfoque de capacidades en educación superior: una revisión sistemática Learning evaluation in the capabilities approach in higher education: a systematic review The article presents the results of a systematic review on the assessment of learning from the capability approach in higher education. The identified problem lies in the fact that, although higher education curricula—including teacher education—declare the adoption of this approach, the assessment practices applied to students are not always consistent with its principles. In this context, the objective of the study was to identify the characteristics of the capability approach that are considered in learning assessment within higher education institutions. The review was conducted through a systematic search of academic databases and the Information System on Educational Trends in Latin America (SITEAL), which made it possible to identify relevant gaps in the literature, particularly regarding the theoretical and practical articulation between learning assessment and the capability approach. Nevertheless, convergences were found around emerging assessment practices, such as formative assessment, aimed at valuing student autonomy, diversity, and critical thinking. title: Uso de las tecnologías de la información y la comunicación en la formación profesional de los estudiantes de Educación de una universidad pública Use of information and communication technologies in the professional training of Education students at a public university
text_snippet: Uso de las tecnologías de la información y la comunicación en la formación profesional de los estudiantes de Educación de una universidad pública Use of information and communication technologies in the professional training of Education students at a public university The study aimed to highlight the importance of Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) in the professional training of future teachers. It was developed under a qualitative approach, at a basic level, with a systematic review design based on the PRISMA 2020 guidelines. The content analysis technique was applied using a documentary analysis matrix. Twenty scientific articles published between 2020 and 2024 in Spanish and English, with open access and full text, were selected. The database that contained the largest number of articles was SciELO (35% of the total analyzed). In conclusion, the review shows a growing academic interest in the use of ICT in professional training, emphasizing the need to incorporate them systematically into educational contexts to promote more innovative, inclusive, and relevant education.

title: Pedagogía y Andragogía: hacia un modelo educativo mixto Pedagogy and Andragogy: toward a mixed educational model
text_snippet: Pedagogía y Andragogía: hacia un modelo educativo mixto Pedagogy and Andragogy: toward a mixed educational model Higher education faces the challenge of adapting its strategies to the diversity of students’ learning paces and styles. Traditionally, pedagogy has been the predominant approach to teaching, even in higher education. In contrast, andragogy offers a model of self-directed and experiential learning. The aim of this study was to propose a mixed educational model to improve university training, through a systematic review based on the PRISMA protocol. A total of 76 articles were identified, of which 10 were selected according to quality and relevance criteria established by the JADAD scale. The results indicate that the integration of pedagogical and andragogical strategies fosters active participation, autonomy, and the development of critical competencies in university students. It is concluded that a mixed model constitutes a necessary alternative to strengthen the quality of higher education and respond to the demands of a transforming society.

title: Pedagogía y Andragogía: hacia un modelo educativo mixto Pedagogy and Andragogy: Toward a Mixed Educational Model
text_snippet: Pedagogía y Andragogía: hacia un modelo educativo mixto Pedagogy and Andragogy: Toward a Mixed Educational Model La educación universitaria enfrenta el reto de adaptar sus estrategias a la diversidad de ritmos y estilos de aprendizaje de los estudiantes. Tradicionalmente, la pedagogía ha sido el enfoque predominante en la enseñanza, incluso en la educación superior. Frente a ello, la andragogía, ofrece un modelo de aprendizaje autodirigido y experiencial. Este estudio se trazó como objetivo la propuesta de un modelo educativo mixto para la mejora de la formación superior, empleando una revisión sistemática basado en el protocolo PRISMA e identificando 76 artículos de los cuales se seleccionaron 10 con base en criterios de calidad, pertinencia basados en la escala JADAD. Los resultados señalan que la integración de estrategias pedagógicas andragógicas mejora la participación activa, autonomía y desarrollo de competencias críticas en estudiantes universitarios. Se concluye que un modelo mixto es una alternativa necesaria para mejorar la calidad de la educación superior, respondiendo a demandas de una sociedad en transformación.

Despite their educational and cultural value, his works have been marginalized within the national school curriculum. This study qualitatively analyzes his literary production, highlighting his pedagogical contributions (moral values, reader formation) and the use of Amazonian verbal mimesis (imitation of regional speech). A biographical-narrative method and content analysis of 43 stories were employed, complemented by semi-structured interviews with specialists and family members. The results show that his literature combines didactic intent with aesthetic quality, rescues Amazonian oral tradition through idioms and local dialects, and can be used as a pedagogical resource to promote reading. The discussion emphasizes that his work reflects Amazonian culture and provides a valuable contribution to the Peruvian educational curriculum in terms of interculturality and comprehensive education. title: ¿Ha tenido cambios el estudiante de pregrado en la modalidad distancia – virtual? ¿Has the undergraduate student had changes in the distance – virtual modality?
text_snippet: ¿Ha tenido cambios el estudiante de pregrado en la modalidad distancia – virtual? ¿Has the undergraduate student had changes in the distance – virtual modality? The aim of this study was to analyze changes in the sociodemographic, economic, and institutional profile of undergraduate students enrolled in distance–virtual programs at the Faculty of Distance Studies of the Universidad Militar Nueva Granada (Colombia). A quantitative, non-experimental, descriptive-comparative, cross-sectional design was employed. Two cohorts corresponding to the academic periods 2015-II and 2024-I were compared using data collected through a structured survey applied to a representative probabilistic sample (n = 494). The results reveal significant transformations in the composition of the student population, including an increase in younger students (17–21 years old), greater participation of individuals from lower socioeconomic strata, and increased territorial diversification. Additionally, changes in funding mechanisms were observed, with a predominance of scholarships and government support, alongside a decline in debt-based financing schemes. In the technological domain, improvements in access to connectivity and digital devices were identified; however, gaps persist in the systematic use of academic digital resources. title: Orientación vocacional desde la perspectiva de las inteligencias múltiples en educación media Vocational guidance from the perspective of multiple intelligences in secondary education
text_snippet: Orientación vocacional desde la perspectiva de las inteligencias múltiples en educación media Vocational guidance from the perspective of multiple intelligences in secondary education The study interpreted vocational guidance through Howard Gardner’s theory of multiple intelligences, with the aim of understanding how this perspective can enrich academic and professional support processes for secondary education students. A qualitative study with a phenomenological-hermeneutic approach was conducted through in-depth interviews with four key informants from educational institutions in the state of Barinas (Venezuela). Inductive analysis, supported by Atlas.ti 24, enabled the identification of categories related to the vocational guidance approach and multiple intelligences, highlighting the need to align guidance practices with the diversity of students’ talents and cognitive styles. The findings show that incorporating this theory promotes more personalized, reflective, and life-project-oriented guidance, contributing to students’ comprehensive academic and human development.

title: Suicidio y pérdida de sentido en la modernidad: el papel educativo de la escuela en la formación de narrativas vitales Suicide and modernity Suicide and loss of meaning in modernity: the educational role of the school in the formation of life narratives

El estudio se orienta a comprender el suicidio no como un fenómeno estrictamente individual o patológico, sino como una manifestación del sufrimiento social producido por la desigualdad, la fragmentación comunitaria y la crisis de sentido en las sociedades contemporáneas. Metodológicamente, se desarrolló una investigación teórico-documental de enfoque cualitativo, sustentada en una perspectiva hermenéutico-crítica. Se revisó un corpus de fuentes secundarias —libros, artículos científicos, tesis e informes institucionales—, articulando aportes clásicos (Durkheim, Marx, Halbwachs & Elias) con estudios recientes sobre juventudes, afectividad escolar y educación. title: Educación financiera y finanzas personales: una competencia clave para el bienestar en estudiantes universitario Financial education and personal finances: a key competence for the well-being of university students
text_snippet: Educación financiera y finanzas personales: una competencia clave para el bienestar en estudiantes universitario Financial education and personal finances: a key competence for the well-being of university students This study addresses the importance of developing financial competencies among university students, emphasizing its significant impact on both their personal and professional lives. It is a theoretical-documentary analysis that examines previous records and evidence on financial education and personal finance. The adopted methodology was qualitative, basic in nature, with a systematic review design using the PRISMA method. A content analysis technique and an instrument based on an analysis matrix were employed. Ten relevant studies published between 2024 and 2019 in Spanish and with open access were selected. The results reveal that despite progress in understanding these topics, there are still deficiencies in integrating educational strategies that promote responsible management of economic resources. It is concluded that implementing financial education programs in university curricula is crucial to prepare young people for the challenges of a complex economic system, fostering habits of saving, planning, and informed decision-making that contribute to their overall well-being.

title: Gestión educativa y reconocimiento oficial de estudios superiores en México: validez de estudios, titulación y cédulas profesionales Educational management and official recognition of higher education studies in Mexico: academic validation, degree awarding, and professional licensing
text_snippet: Gestión educativa y reconocimiento oficial de estudios superiores en México: validez de estudios, titulación y cédulas profesionales Educational management and official recognition of higher education studies in Mexico: academic validation, degree awarding, and professional licensing This study aimed to analyze educational management and the official recognition of higher education studies in Mexico, with emphasis on the validity of academic programs, university degree awarding, and the issuance of professional licenses, considering the implications arising from the coexistence of federal and state-level schemes. Methodologically, a qualitative documentary research design was adopted, with an analytical-interpretative orientation and grounded in the hermeneutic-analytical method. The corpus consisted of 42 normative and institutional documents, as well as relevant academic literature published between 2015 and 2024, selected based on criteria of relevance and regulatory validity. The analysis was conducted in four phases: document collection, thematic classification, normative comparison, and interpretative integration through an analytical matrix, complemented by source triangulation to strengthen traceability and analytical consistency. title: Relación entre la inteligencia emocional y la gestión pedagógica en docentes de instituciones públicas de Lima Relationship between emotional intelligence and pedagogical management in teachers from public institutions in Lima
text_snippet: Relación entre la inteligencia emocional y la gestión pedagógica en docentes de instituciones públicas de Lima Relationship between emotional intelligence and pedagogical management in teachers from public institutions in Lima The present study aimed to analyze the relationship between emotional intelligence and pedagogical management among early childhood teachers from public educational institutions in the Local Educational Management Unit (UGEL) 04 in Lima. A quantitative approach was employed with a non-experimental, correlational, and cross-sectional research design. The sample consisted of 40 teachers selected through non-probabilistic convenience sampling. Data were collected using a survey technique, applying the Bar-On Emotional Intelligence Inventory and a pedagogical management scale, both instruments presenting evidence of validity and adequate levels of reliability. The results showed a positive correlation of low magnitude between emotional intelligence and pedagogical management (ρ = 0.269); however, this association did not reach statistical significance (p = 0.094). title: Relación de la Inteligencia emocional y la gestión pedagógica en docentes de instituciones públicas de Lima Relationship between emotional intelligence and pedagogical management in teachers of public institutions in Lima
text_snippet: Relación de la Inteligencia emocional y la gestión pedagógica en docentes de instituciones públicas de Lima Relationship between emotional intelligence and pedagogical management in teachers of public institutions in Lima The objective of the study was to establish the relationship between emotional intelligence and pedagogical management in teachers of public institutions in Lima. The approach used was quantitative, with a descriptive-correlational and cross-sectional design. The sample was made up of 40 initial level teachers from three public institutions of the UGEL 04. The instruments applied were the Reuven Bar-On Emotional Intelligence Inventory and the Pedagogical Management Scale, both validated and with reliability measurement. To analyze the evaluation between the variables, Spearman's Rho evaluation coefficient was used. The analysis considered an evaluation of 0.269, which indicates a weak positive relationship between emotional intelligence and pedagogical management. However, the significance value (0.094) was higher than the common accepted threshold of 0.05, which implies that the null hypothesis (H0) cannot be rejected. Consequently, there is not enough evidence to affirm that there is a significant relationship between emotional intelligence and pedagogical management in the sample analyzed.

title: Estrategias cognitivo-interpretativas y desarrollo del pensamiento crítico en estudiantes de posgrado de una universidad pública de Lima Cognitive-interpretive strategies and the development of critical thinking in graduate students at a public university in Lima

En la fase diagnóstica se aplicó un cuestionario, validado por juicio de expertos, compuesto por 42 ítems organizados en 10 dimensiones, para evaluar competencias asociadas al pensamiento crítico. title: Estrategias Cogninterpretativas en el desarrollo del pensamiento crítico en los estudiantes de la escuela de posgrado de una universidad pública de Lima Cognitive-Interpretive strategies in the development of critical thinking in graduate students at a public university in Lima
text_snippet: Estrategias Cogninterpretativas en el desarrollo del pensamiento crítico en los estudiantes de la escuela de posgrado de una universidad pública de Lima Cognitive-Interpretive strategies in the development of critical thinking in graduate students at a public university in Lima The objective of this research was to develop a pedagogical proposal to foster critical thinking in third-cycle master’s students specializing in University Teaching at a public university in Lima. The methodology was framed within the socio-critical paradigm, with a projective approach and holistic design, as the changes sought to encourage reflection and action among the 108 participants, selected through probabilistic sampling. During the diagnostic phase, a survey validated by experts was applied, consisting of 42 items distributed across 10 dimensions, aimed at assessing competencies related to critical thinking. The results revealed that students possess some competencies that support critical thinking, such as skills for critical reading and content interpretation. Despite these strengths, areas for improvement and opportunities to enhance participants’ cognitive skills were identified. title: Relación entre la inteligencia emocional y la gestión pedagógica en docentes de instituciones públicas de Lima Relationship between emotional intelligence and pedagogical management in teachers from public institutions in Lima
text_snippet: Relación entre la inteligencia emocional y la gestión pedagógica en docentes de instituciones públicas de Lima Relationship between emotional intelligence and pedagogical management in teachers from public institutions in Lima El presente estudio tuvo como finalidad establecer la relación entre la inteligencia emocional y la gestión pedagógica en docentes de instituciones educativas públicas de Lima. Se empleó un enfoque cuantitativo, con diseño no experimental, de nivel correlacional y corte transversal. La muestra estuvo conformada por 40 docentes de nivel inicial de tres instituciones educativas públicas de la UGEL 04. Los instrumentos utilizados fueron el Inventario de Bar-On para medir la inteligencia emocional y una escala de gestión pedagógica, ambos validados y con adecuada confiabilidad. Para el análisis de la relación entre variables se utilizó el coeficiente Rho de Spearman, obteniéndose una correlación positiva débil (ρ = 0,269); sin embargo, esta no fue estadísticamente significativa (p = 0,094), por lo que no se halló evidencia suficiente para afirmar una relación significativa entre ambas variables en la muestra estudiada.
